items.q: Which of the following best describes Address operator?
o: a mistake in the grammar of a language that stops the translator from producing an output file
the use of an asterisk to reach the item whose location is held
the stream a program writes its results to by default, usually the screen
the ampersand that yields the location of an item in memory
items.s: Address operator: the ampersand that yields the location of an item in memory. The other options describe Syntax error, Standard output, Indirection.

items.q: Which term is described by “a word that already has a fixed meaning in a language and cannot be used as a name”?

Keyword
Variable
Constant
items.s: Keyword is a word that already has a fixed meaning in a language and cannot be used as a name.

Interpreter

the case in which a routine calls itself on a smaller version of the same problem
the instructions a programmer writes in a high level language before translation into machine language
the value returned when a data file is opened and used in later operations on it
items.s: Recursion: the case in which a routine calls itself on a smaller version of the same problem. The other options describe Flowchart, Stream handle, Source code.

items.q: The statement “the statement that leaves the innermost repetition or choice at once” describes which of the following?

Endless cycle
Repetition
items.s: Break is the statement that leaves the innermost repetition or choice at once.

the keyword that gives a new name to an existing type
the practice of breaking a problem into smaller parts until each part is easy to write
a value passed into a routine when it is called
items.s: Typedef: the keyword that gives a new name to an existing type. The other options describe Stepwise refinement, Conditional statement, Argument.

the part that runs when the test of a two way branch fails
a named storage location whose value may change while a program runs
the pool of memory from which blocks are taken while a program runs and returned when finished
items.s: Free store: the pool of memory from which blocks are taken while a program runs and returned when finished. The other options describe Syntax error, Else clause, Variable.

the pool of memory from which blocks are taken while a program runs and returned when finished
